# Scott Lewis

## About
Scott Lewis is a senior full stack developer focused on building modern web applications, cloud-native solutions, and developer tooling with React, .NET, and JavaScript-based product engineering.

## Professional focus
- Full stack web development
- React and TypeScript application architecture
- .NET, cloud integration, and backend services
- Product engineering, mentoring, and team leadership
